newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers ease by $2-$4/T on weak crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers ease by $2-$4/T on weak crude.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday eased on crude losses and weak demand as most buyers were sidelined, expecting prices to fall further, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst prices were quoted at $122-$123 per tonne, lower from Wednesday's quotes at $123-$126.
Prices for 380 cst were steady at $118, in the absence of bids.
"Most shipowners were expecting prices to ease further as they projected cargo prices to move lower," said a broker.
MDO prices were also little changed at $223-228 and gas oil at $234-$238. -- Singapore newsroom (+65-870-3082)
